newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia rubber stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia rubber stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian tyre-grade March SIR20 offer prices were generally stable late on Tuesday but trading remained listless in the absence of consumer demand, dealers said.
They said they did not expect any activity ahead of the celebration of Eid al-Fitr on February 9 and 10 and the upcoming Lunar New Year holidays in Singapore.

Dealers said March SIR20 offer prices were quoted at 53.25 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and Surabaya, up 0.25 cents. Rubber was offered at 53.00 U.S. cents/lb fob Padang as well as 52.50 in Jambi and Pontianak.
"I don't hear of any deals and traders do not expect any activity ahead of the Eid al-Fitr celebration and holidays in Singapore," said one trader.

Dealers said the weak U.S. demand had dampened market sentiment. They also said the market generally had shrugged off rises in Tokyo. "The rise has had no impact on the market because there are not many offers coming from Japan," said one trader.
Tokyo rubber futures ended higher across the board on Tuesday, due mainly to short-covering by private investors as the dollar posted gains against the yen.
